unit: CH-03 F053 / F116 - person-identity convergence, batch 2
objective: Make AuraPersonIdentity the canonical deserialisation and identity-semantics boundary for person identity on the client - not merely to lower a count.

slicesMigrated.note: The ACTING authority. It insisted the person be nested under `user` and unpacked the fields itself, so a differently-shaped payload produced NO acting context at all - the F057 failure mode in the one place that decides who an act is attributed to.
The nav names the signed-in person canonically. `title` (an institutional role line) stays a local read - destination-specific composition preserved, not absorbed.
Profile header and the follows fetch now resolve the same handle. `bio`/`headline`/`summary`/`title` are profile CONTENT and deliberately stay put.
A mention suggestion now describes the same person the mention resolves to.
Bounded mention scope. The literal 'Member' stand-in for an unresolved person is gone.
Its inline chain already ended in 'Someone'; the shared fallback now supplies that from one place.
F052's subject - identity in a REALTIME surface. A ringing call now names the caller through the same model the thread does.
'Author' was an invented label for an unresolved person. `bio` stays local.
The picker names a person exactly as the conversation it starts will.
Identity read canonically; `reasons` and `followState` are discovery state and stay on the suggestion. Composition, not flattening.
`actorName` survives as a LEGACY flattened field, consulted only when the canonical person cannot be resolved - it no longer competes with the canonical read.

privateTypedBoundaryConverged.why: AuthorBrief was id + handle + displayName + avatarUrl - a byte-for-byte subset of AuraPersonIdentity with a different name, and it had ZERO consumers. Section C case 1 exactly: a renamed subset of person identity. Deleted rather than wrapped.

identifiedButNotConverged.state: LIVE via AuthorTile in search. Carries `bio` alongside identity, so the honest convergence is `Author { AuraPersonIdentity person; String bio; }` rather than deletion. It reads no person fields off maps, so it carries NO measured debt; converging it is available refactoring, not debt repair, and was left alone rather than churned.

instrumentCorrection.what: The audit counted `state.pathParameters['handle']` in lib/router.dart as identity debt - SIX sites.
instrumentCorrection.why it was wrong: A ROUTE PARAMETER named `handle` is not a person payload. Reading a URL segment performs no identity interpretation, so no migration could ever have cleared those sites: the measurement OVERSTATED the remaining work.
instrumentCorrection.declaredSeparately: This is a measurement fix, NOT a migration, and is reported apart from the migrated sites so the two are never confused. It reduces the count without changing any product code.
instrumentCorrection.gamingCheck: No local parsing was moved into a helper to hide it. Every other cleared site had its competing person interpretation actually removed.

authorityChange.why: A real destination-specific need found by an existing test: notification copy is a SENTENCE. 'amjad sent you a message' reads correctly; '@amjad sent you a message' does not. The FALLBACK ORDER stays canonical (name, then handle, then the neutral word) - only the decoration belongs to the sentence. Two renderings of one order, never two orders.
authorityChange.notWidened: No payload shapes were added to the reader to absorb odd inputs. `me_screen`'s legacy `avatar` alias is adapted AT that boundary instead.

identityDebt.ratchet: FAILED on every reduction until explicitly re-frozen, as designed. Re-frozen at 49 / 131.

protectedSitesRemaining.disposition: LEFT PROTECTED AND UNTOUCHED. Migrating them would improve the count while crossing the Meetings boundary for convenience, which the boundary exists to prevent. They are not blocked by anything technical: a narrow founder authorization of the kind granted for RC8 would make them executable in minutes.

findingStates.F053: PARTIALLY_VALIDATED - unchanged. The authority now exists and 71 of the enumerated sites are cleared, but 131 remain and PB-05 forbids closing on a partial migration.
findingStates.F116: PARTIALLY_VALIDATED - unchanged, same reason. Its exact remainder is now measurable rather than narrative: 32 ad-hoc surface sites, 99 non-conformant (mostly BACKEND select sites), 75 private typed boundaries.
findingStates.F052: Advanced in substance, unchanged in state: the realtime incoming-call surface it names now consumes the canonical model. Certification remains owed and is not claimed.
findingStates.F054/F055/F056/F057: Unchanged. No new structural debt was exposed by this migration; F057's defect class is now structurally impossible in the migrated surfaces because they share one reader.
findingStates.F051: UNTOUCHED - preserved conflict, not adjudicated, not implicitly resolved by any model migration.
findingStates.discipline: No finding advanced or closed. Progress is a measured debt reduction behind a ratchet.

verification.identityConformanceGate: PASS at the new baseline 49 files / 131 sites
verification.realConsumingSurfaceTests: The existing notification-presentation suite caught the prose/mention distinction on its own - a real consuming-surface test doing exactly what it exists for.

founderDecisionsRequired: OPTIONAL, surfaced not asked: two Meetings files still hold 5 identity sites. A narrow authorization like RC8's would let them converge; without it they stay protected and the debt figure keeps them.
